_provenance: NOT captured from a live session. Transcribed from the Claude Code hooks documentation on 2026-09-15 while implementing ADR-009, because hook configuration is read at session start and a session cannot observe a hook it registered mid-flight. tests/fixtures/hook_payloads.json holds the payloads that WERE captured from a real session; these are not in it and must not be moved into it until a real one is recorded. stdtel-doctor reports each of these events as 'not yet observed' on a machine where it has never fired, so nothing here is mistaken for evidence that capture works. PostCompact was removed on 2026-10-13 (#156): a real payload, captured from Claude Code 2.1.296, carries `trigger` and `compact_summary` and none of the documented `compaction_reason` / `token_count_estimate_*` fields, so every compaction recorded `reason=unknown` with no tokens. The real payload is in hook_payloads.json.
